visualCharacteristics.purpose: Comparison grid: label column + shadowed white model columns, product images in the header rows, row dividers, CTA row
visualCharacteristics.description: No table variants exist. Product comparison: label column + 3 shadowed white model columns with a linked product image row, divider lines between rows and a CTA row (outline button in the label column, red buttons for models).

contentPattern.summary: Comparison grid (CSS grid div1..div32): label column (Throughput, Deck Capacity, Dimensions, Pipetting volume range, Configuration options, 'Talk to an Expert' outline button) + 3 shadowed model columns (Biomek i3/i5/i7: bold name, linked product image, 5 values incl. bullet lists, 'Explore Biomek iN' red button)
contentPattern.structure: rows of [label | model 1 | model 2 | ...]: row 1 model names, row 2 product images, attribute rows, last row CTA links; up to 3 models (4 cells per row), empty model columns are dropped

reuseGuidance: Use to compare product models side by side. For a 2-column spec sheet use table-specs.
